Everything else unchanged; validation read once, final test locked. Earlier results keep the decision they got.
_minimum_trades: Below this in a split the decision is 'inconclusive'. Trades per year are reported; day trading aims at 200+ per year.
_net: Compounded net return over the split must beat floor x (1 + 0.1 x prior variants) in BOTH the base and the conservative cost scenarios. Prior variants = distinct (rule, market) pairs already read on exploration (research/b3/ledger.jsonl).
_positive_years: Share of calendar years in the split with a positive net return (base cost) must be at least this.
split_progression: A rule must pass on exploration and then, read ONCE, on validation of the same market before it becomes a candidate for the demo forward test. The final test is never read while splits_b3.json final_test_unlocked is false.
